rv.q: It is superficially lively but emotionally in the clouds.
The whole thing emerges as an entertainingly original twist on a familiar fable.
Undeniably bold, inclusive, and memorable, Jack and The Beanstalk: A New Moosical is a West End-worthy festive spectacle with dazzling puppetry and a star-making turn from McAdam.
Visually, the show could hardly be more impressive, with a mind-blowing beanstalk scene to round off the first half, and a terrific animatronic giant in the second.

cn.t: Critics give this inventive "moosical" retelling mostly positive marks for its bold cow-centric twist on the classic tale, though some feel Jack gets overshadowed in his own story.
